target.description: Id of one {group} (all its {nodes}) or of one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`)

compareWith.description: Id of another {group} or {node} to compare with; must not equal or overlap target

owner.description: INUBIT user or user group owning the system diagrams, for every {node}; default: inventory.owner of each {node}

search.description: Part of a partner's Id, name or other non-secret partner field (case-insensitive); without it, all partners are listed

systemDiagram.description: Only this system diagram (name, exact, case-insensitive, any diagram group)

protocol.description: Only entries of this protocol (the entry's protocol attribute, e.g. FTP; exact, case-insensitive)

workflow.description: Only entries referencing this technical workflow (name, exact, case-insensitive)
